name: broods
description: Serverless, multi-account AI agent harness built on AWS Lambda and Bun. The open-source engine behind Broods.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run --filter @broods/core check && bun run --filter @broods/convex check && bun run --filter @broods/gateway check && bun run --filter @broods/dashboard check && bun run --filter @broods/discord-forwarder check && bun run --filter broods check && bun run --filter @broods/ai-sdk-sandbox check && bun run scripts:check
scripts.test: bun run --filter @broods/core test && bun run --filter @broods/convex test
